value.title: Primo assaggio
value.synopsis: Toshihiko dedicated his life to only one purpose, to hunt down and destroy the Shokujinki, until the day he met Yuka.

value.title: Duri addii
value.synopsis: Toshihiko's life changed drastically when his father dies, and Yuka's true nature is revealed to him.

value.title: Notte salata di luna nuova
value.synopsis: Toshihiko escaped with Yuka and they hide themselves in a far away mansion.

value.title: Amarezza del passato
value.synopsis: The story of Toshiko's father is finally revealed, as how he became the leader of the Kifūken and his relationship with Yuka's mother.

value.title: Il sapore nascosto della donna
value.synopsis: Kyūtarō exposes his plan to reformulate the Kifūken's organization with the help of Kazuma. Trouble arises when another member of the school gets himself involved with a Shokujinki.

value.title: Compleanno piccante
value.synopsis: Yuka celebrates her birthday with Toshihiko, but when she tried one of his secret immobilization techniques on him, he ends up paralyzed, just when their gigantic pursuer finds them.

value.title: Il dolce profumo di Rie
value.synopsis: Rie discovers Toshihiko's hideout and goes all out trying to bring him back home. Meanwhile, Yuka has a surprising revelation.

value.title: La detenzione ha il sapore del ferro
value.synopsis: Toshihiko is captured and tortured by a group of Shokujinki commanded by Yuka's former lover. But soon the Kifūken discovers their location and storm the place.

value.title: Sogni d'oro
value.synopsis: Once again on the run, Toshihiko and Yuka take a hike with a kind old couple. While traveling with them, they try to sort out their feelings for each other.

value.title: Le disgrazie altrui hanno il sapore del miele
value.synopsis: As Kyūtarō Ōba put his master plan in motion, he finally reveals his true colors.

value.title: La pioggia era amara
value.synopsis: Ōba transforms Rie in a Shokujinki and put her into a fight against Yuka. Meanwhile, Kazuma discovers the truth about his origin.

value.title: Gnocchi di miglio aromatizzati al caffè
value.synopsis: While Toshihiko tries to convince Rie's father to join his battle against Ōba, Kazuma rushes to fight him by himself.

value.title: Il gusto non c'entra nulla
value.synopsis: Toshihiko and his allies struggle to stop Ōba's ambitions.
